mentions.name: Historical Setting Media Database
mentions.description: This is a database cataloging films, TV shows, games, and other media by their historical setting, recording what year or historical period each work is set in and where. The project is in its early stages.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a database of film, tv, games etc based around historical setting: in what year or historical period was the thing set, and where.
